name: SE Ranking
description: An all-in-one SEO and digital marketing platform providing comprehensive data APIs and project management tools for keywords, backlinks, rank tracking, and domain analysis.

evidence.claim: SE Ranking offers two APIs (Data API and Project API) authenticated with a single API key using Token auth.
Keyword Research API supports bulk keyword data retrieval via REST POST requests.
SE Ranking provides an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for integration with AI assistants.
SE Ranking offers official client libraries, tools, and sample projects on GitHub.

notes: SE Ranking provides both a Data API (credit-based) and a Project API (subscription-limit based) authenticated via a single API key using token auth. They also offer an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for native AI client integrations.
